subject: Urgent: request to convert live pairing to recorded + short call
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@example.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: request to convert live pairing to recorded + short call

Hi Monica and Marissa,

I'm really sorry for the last-minute message — my partner just had to go to the ER (not life-threatening) and I need to be with our toddler this afternoon. I will still be able to do the technical exercise but I won’t be able to join a full live pairing at 3pm PT.

Would Redwood consider one of the following alternatives so I don't lose the slot?

1) I record a 25–30 minute screen-share of the pairing exercise (I can use a provided Collab/CodeSandbox link) and then hop on a 15-minute phone call with the hiring manager later the same day for questions.
2) If recording is not possible, I can do a 60-minute take-home and return the code within 24 hours, then do the 15-minute call.

I understand live pairing is the default; I'm happy to follow any instructions you need for the recording. Attached is my resume for convenience.

Apologies again — I really value this interview. Please let me know if either option could work.

Best,
Aisha Khan

Attachments: candidate_resume.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@example.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: request to convert live pairing to recorded + short call

Thanks for the heads-up, Aisha — I'm sorry to hear about your partner and hope they're okay. We can absolutely be flexible here; thank you for suggesting options.

Quick internal note for the team: candidate has a family medical issue this afternoon and is requesting to submit a recorded pairing + short live debrief rather than the scheduled live pairing at 3pm PT. This is a one-time exception request.

Proposed plan:
- Approve Aisha's option #1: 25–30 min recorded screen-share following our standard pairing rubric (see attached).
- Schedule a 15-minute live debrief with Rishi (hiring manager) later today; recruiter to propose windows.
- Recruiter to provide Collab link and the "recording checklist" we ask candidates to follow (camera optional, please narrate thinking).

Marissa — can you confirm the 15-minute windows you can propose to Aisha and send the recording checklist + pairing-instructions.md?

Rishi / Irene — looping you in for quick approval; if you need the live pairing still, flag here, otherwise we'll proceed with recorded + 15-min live debrief.

Attachments: pairing-instructions.md (text)

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@example.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request to convert live pairing to recorded + short call

Monica — thanks for the context and for proposing a clear workaround. I'm fine approving the recorded pairing for this case. A couple of quick constraints so the interview debrief is useful:

- Ask Aisha to share a 25–30 minute screen recording of the pairing exercise (no audio necessary if preferred), but please include short text notes on why they made key design choices (2–3 bullet points).
- After we review the recording, I'll do a 15-minute live call (phone or Google Meet) with Aisha to ask clarifying questions and assess collaboration.
- Please make sure the candidate uses the provided sandbox link and doesn't paste private code from employers.

Marissa — can you offer two 15-minute windows today between 4:30pm–6:30pm PT? If not today, tomorrow morning is fine. Once Aisha confirms, Monicawill send the sandbox link and the recording checklist.

Irene — if you'd like to weigh in on any technical scope adjustments, feel free. Otherwise, consider this approved.

Thanks,
Rishi
Hiring Manager, Platform Team
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@example.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request to convert live pairing to recorded + short call

Thank you — and thank you everyone for the flexibility. The ER visit was for a minor issue; we're stable. I can do the recorded option and would prefer a 5:30pm PT live debrief if that works for Rishi.

I have one quick question about the recording: do you prefer MP4 export or a Zoom cloud recording link? I can provide either. I followed the checklist you attached and will also add the 2–3 bullet reasoning notes in a short README.

I'll wait for the sandbox link and confirmation of the 5:30pm PT slot.

Best,
Aisha

Attachments: screen-recording-checklist.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
